processing: Trim, resample, layer, fade and peak-normalize to 0.82. No oscillator layers in recorded attack cues.

battle_music.composition: Original 32-bar Arkmon battle theme in D minor, 160 BPM; horn theme, bowed figures, contrasting flute section and full reprise

battle_music.reference_direction: User-supplied Pokemon Hype Mix title as an energy/mood reference. Original melody; linked video was not available for listening.

summoning_cues.processing: Spectral rolloff, stretching, shaped envelopes and short stereo reflections; no oscillators or two-note melody. Arrival cue triggers at materialization completion only.

fantasy_battle_preview.soundfont: GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 by S. Christian Collins
fantasy_battle_preview.reference: Theophany Colgera arrangement: mood reference only; no source audio or melody copied

tower_ambience.note: Quiet distant grass footsteps, wood creaks and cloth breeze, mixed from the Kenney CC0 sources above.

horse.author: DenisChardonnet
horse.title: Breath of a horse #2
horse.processing: Original recording; force-to-mono import. Quiet occasional playback with mild pitch variation.

foley.author: Kenney
foley.note: Recorded cloth foley reused as gentle brushing and rustling; these are not horse vocal recordings.

stable_ambience.runtime: StableLocalFoley uses player distance rather than the high camera, fades out at 14 units, ducks during dialogue, mutes at transitions and never plays in batch mode.

hoof.author: Joseph SARDIN
hoof.title: Horse steps on concrete
hoof.processing: Recorded hoof foley, not a synthesized sound. Isolated 0.245-second attack from 1.9506s, DC removal, 4ms fade-in, 45ms fade-out, peak 0.48, mono PCM16 48kHz. Quiet playback when an occasional small hoof lift settles.

workshop_planing.author: DeqstersLab
workshop_planing.title: Stanley No. 3 Hand Plane, Fine Set Face Planing, Doug Fir
workshop_planing.processing: Two 0.5-second excerpts from the public HQ preview at 5.2s and 5.9s; DC removal, 35ms fade-in, 85ms fade-out, peak 0.65, mono PCM16 at 32kHz. Alternated on forward cuts only; player-distance attenuation and dialogue interruption. No synthesis.
